name: Search Your Email
description: Help the user find an old email by searching for a name, word, or subject
prompt:
The user wants to find an old email. FIRST reassure them: searching never deletes or moves anything — it just shows them the matching messages. Ask what they remember about the email (the sender's name, a word in the subject, or a topic). Assume Gmail unless they say otherwise.

VISUAL GUIDE — SEARCHING GMAIL: 4 steps.

  Step 1: image_id `gmail-illustrated-step-1`. Text: "Open Gmail in your browser as you normally do."
  Step 2: image_id `gmail-search-bar`. Text: "At the very top of the page is a long white search box. Click inside it."
  Step 3: image_id `gmail-search-bar`. Text: "Type a name, word, or anything you remember about the email — for example the sender's first name. Then press Enter on your keyboard."
  Step 4: image_id `gmail-search-results`. Text: "Gmail shows every email that matches. Click the one you want to read. To go back to your full inbox, click the **Inbox** link on the left side. 🎉"

If they don't find it, suggest trying a different word, or just the sender's first name. Mention that emails older than a few years may take a moment to load.
